name: AI Content Generator & Calculator Builder by TalkGenAI
author: talkgenai

sections.description:
SEO got you here. GEO takes you further.

Google isn’t the only one answering questions anymore. ChatGPT, Gemini, and Perplexity are serving answers directly to your audience. TalkGenAI helps you create content that AI engines can trust, cite, and recommend. Every article is structured to strengthen your E-E-A-T signals — so both search engines and AI models see your site as an authoritative source.

AI-Powered Content Generation

Generate publish-ready articles right inside WordPress. Every article includes:

  • Internal Links – Automatically links to your existing content, building topical authority across your site
  • External Links – Cites authoritative sources that AI engines trust and verify
  • FAQ Sections + JSON-LD Schema – Structured Q&A that AI engines can pull directly into conversational answers
  • AI Hero Image – Generates a photorealistic featured image matched to your article topic (paid plans)
  • Meta Descriptions – Optimized summaries tuned for both traditional and AI-powered search
  • Save as WordPress Draft – One click publishes directly to your WordPress drafts — no copy/paste needed
  • Any Language – Write in English, Hebrew, Spanish, French, German, and more

Just type your topic, toggle on the features you want, and TalkGenAI generates a complete, publish-ready article in seconds.

Interactive Widgets — Auto-Embedded in Articles

When TalkGenAI generates an article, it automatically decides what interactive tool fits the content — a mortgage calculator for a real estate post, a comparison table for a review, a chart for a data piece — and embeds it inside the article. No separate step. No developer. No other AI writer does this.

TalkGenAI is also a standalone AI-powered widget builder. Instead of configuring complex settings or hiring a developer, you describe what you need:

“Create a mortgage calculator with loan amount, interest rate, and term length” – done in 10 seconds.

  • Calculators – Mortgage, BMI, ROI, cost estimators, quote generators, loan, savings, currency converters
  • Interactive Charts – Bar, line & pie charts with hover tooltips, axis labels and auto-extracted data
  • Infographics – Stats cards, key points, timelines & step flows that highlight article data
  • Countdown Timers – Sales countdowns, product launches, event timers, Pomodoro timers
  • Comparison Tables – Product specs, pricing plans, affiliate charts (AI researches the data for you)
  • To-Do Lists & Checklists – Onboarding flows, shopping lists, process trackers

Every widget is responsive, lightweight, and works with Elementor, Divi, Gutenberg, and Beaver Builder via a simple shortcode.

How It Works (4 Steps)

  1. Open the TalkGenAI dashboard in your WordPress admin
  2. Type what you want: “Build a calorie calculator for women” or “Write an article about home workout routines”
  3. Preview the result – tweak it by chatting: “Add an FAQ section”, “Make the button blue”
  4. Copy the shortcode, paste it into any page or post

Why Site Owners Choose TalkGenAI

Internal links generated automatically. TalkGenAI scans your existing content and links every article to relevant pages on your site — building topical authority without manual work.

Publish-ready in one click. Articles include internal links, external citations, FAQ schema, meta description, and an AI hero image. Save directly as a WordPress draft — no copy/paste.

GEO-ready from day one. Your articles are structured with internal links, external citations, and FAQ sections that AI engines like ChatGPT and Gemini can trust and cite.

The only AI writer that embeds a working tool inside the article. Every other AI writer generates text and stops. TalkGenAI generates the article and automatically places a working calculator, chart, or comparison table inside it — matched to your content, no extra step required.

One plugin instead of many. Most sites need a calculator plugin, a timer plugin, a table plugin. That means 3+ plugins to maintain, update, and troubleshoot. TalkGenAI replaces them all.

No coding, no configuration screens. Other plugins make you drag fields around and configure formulas. With TalkGenAI, you describe the result and the AI writes the HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.

Lightweight output. Each widget is self-contained code – no framework dependencies, no external scripts loaded on your frontend.

Real Examples

Here are actual prompts that produce working results:

  • “Write an article about the best protein powders for beginners” (generates article with internal links to your site, external sources, FAQ schema, and AI hero image)
  • “Mortgage calculator – monthly payment based on home price, down payment, interest rate, and loan term”
  • “Countdown timer to December 31, 2026 with days, hours, minutes, seconds”
  • “Compare iPhone 16 vs Samsung S25 – screen, battery, camera, price” (AI fills in the specs)
  • “BMI calculator with metric and imperial units”
  • “Pricing table for 3 plans: Basic $9/mo, Pro $29/mo, Enterprise $99/mo”

Free Plan Included

Start building immediately — no credit card required:

  • 24 free credits to start — enough for 3 full articles with images
  • 1 website
  • Standard AI model
  • Articles with internal links, external links & FAQ schema
  • ⚡ Interactive apps embedded inside articles — charts, infographics, calculators auto-generated alongside every article
  • Standalone widgets: calculators, timers, comparison tables & checklists

Starter Plan — $39/mo

For creators and growing sites:

  • 150 credits / month
  • Up to 5 websites
  • Premium AI models (better quality, longer articles)
  • 🖼️ AI Hero Image — photorealistic featured image generated for every article
  • 🎙️ Brand Voice — learns your writing style from existing content and applies it to every new article

Growth Plan — $89/mo

For growing businesses:

  • 400 credits / month
  • Up to 10 websites
  • Everything in Starter, plus email support

Agency Plan — $199/mo

For agencies managing multiple sites:

  • 1,000 credits / month
  • Unlimited websites
  • Everything in Growth, plus dedicated WhatsApp account manager

Privacy & External Service Notice

This plugin connects to an external API service to provide AI generation.

Service Provider:

  • Service: TalkGenAI
  • Service URL: https://app.talkgen.ai
  • Terms of Service: Read Terms
  • Privacy Policy: Read Privacy Policy

Data collected when you generate a widget or article:

  • The text prompt you enter (e.g., “Create a BMI calculator”)
  • WordPress site URL, WordPress version, PHP version (for compatibility)
  • Timestamp, IP address (for security), and User ID

Data we do NOT collect:

  • Your site’s database, posts, pages, or media
  • Passwords or personal credentials
  • Data from other plugins

You are responsible for reviewing and testing all generated widgets and articles before publishing. AI can make mistakes – always verify calculations and content.
sections.installation:
Automatic Installation

  1. In your WordPress admin, go to Plugins > Add New
  2. Search for “TalkGenAI”
  3. Click Install Now, then Activate
  4. Register for a free API key at https://app.talkgen.ai
  5. Enter your API key in TalkGenAI > Settings
  6. Go to TalkGenAI > Generate App and describe your first widget or article

Manual Installation

  1. Download the plugin ZIP file
  2. Go to Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin
  3. Upload the ZIP and click Install Now
  4. Activate the plugin
  5. Register at https://app.talkgen.ai for your free API key
  6. Enter the key in TalkGenAI > Settings
sections.faq:
What is GEO (Generative Engine Optimization)?

GEO is the shift from traditional SEO to optimizing for AI-powered search engines like ChatGPT, Gemini, and Perplexity. Instead of just ranking in Google, GEO ensures your content is structured so AI engines can trust, cite, and recommend it. TalkGenAI generates articles that are GEO-ready out of the box.

Is the content optimized for SEO?

Yes. Every article is built for SEO from the ground up — a focus keyword in the title and headings, a clean H2/H3 structure, automatic internal and external links, and FAQ schema markup that search engines can read. Because TalkGenAI optimizes for both classic SEO and GEO (Generative Engine Optimization), your content is positioned to rank in Google and to be cited by AI engines like ChatGPT, Gemini, and Perplexity.

How do I get started?

Install the plugin, get a free API key at app.talkgen.ai, and type your first prompt. Watch the setup video for a quick walkthrough.

Is it really free?

Yes. The free plan gives you 24 credits to start — enough for 3 full articles with images, no credit card required. When you’re ready for more, upgrade to a paid plan.

Do I need to know HTML or JavaScript?

No. You describe what you want in any language – TalkGenAI supports English, Hebrew, Spanish, French, German, and more. The AI writes all the code.

How do the internal and external links work?

When generating an article, TalkGenAI scans your existing posts and pages to find relevant internal link opportunities — and automatically inserts them into the article. It also cites authoritative external sources. This builds topical authority and signals credibility to both traditional search engines and AI engines like ChatGPT and Gemini.

Does it generate images for articles?

Yes. On paid plans, TalkGenAI generates a photorealistic AI hero image for every article using GPT-Image-1. The image is matched to your article topic and inserted automatically. Free plan articles do not include image generation.

Can I publish directly to WordPress?

Yes. After generating an article, click “Save as Draft” to push it directly to your WordPress drafts. It appears in your Posts list ready to review and publish — no copy/paste required.

Can I customize the design after generating?

Yes. Just tell the AI what to change: “Make the background dark”, “Use a larger font”, “Add more FAQ questions”. You can iterate as many times as you want within a single generation.

Does it work with my page builder?

Yes. TalkGenAI outputs a standard WordPress shortcode like [talkgenai_app id="123"]. This works in Gutenberg, Elementor, Divi, Beaver Builder, WPBakery, and any theme that supports shortcodes.

Can I put multiple widgets on the same page?

Yes. Each widget is fully self-contained. You can place a calculator and a countdown timer on the same page and they work independently.

What kinds of calculators can it build?

Mortgage, BMI, ROI, cost estimators, quote generators, loan calculators, savings calculators, currency converters, calorie calculators, tip calculators – anything you can describe.
sections.changelog:
2.7.6 – 2026-07-19

  • Improvement: The check for legacy app data now caches its result, removing two uncached database queries on admin page loads. No change to how the plugin behaves.

2.7.5 – 2026-07-13

  • Feature: Refined articles can now be pushed to the post that is already live. TalkGenAI Cloud updates that post in place, keeping its URL, publish status and featured image, so your edits reach the live page.
  • Fix: Publishing the same article twice no longer creates a duplicate post — the existing post is updated instead.

2.7.4 – 2026-07-12

  • Fix: Internal links now work on sites protected by Cloudflare (and similar firewalls). TalkGenAI Cloud could not read the sitemap of a protected site, so articles were generated with no internal links at all. The plugin now sends your published posts and pages to TalkGenAI Cloud itself, so it never needs to read your site from outside.
  • Improvement: Internal links are more accurate. Link suggestions now use your real post titles, excerpts and permalinks (including category paths and Yoast primary categories) instead of titles guessed from the URL.
  • Improvement: Clearer errors. If a firewall or security plugin blocks TalkGenAI Cloud from reaching your site, you now get an explanation and how to fix it, instead of an unhelpful server error.

2.7.3 – 2026-06-21

  • Feature: Parent page support for auto-publish — choose a Parent page (WordPress Page Attributes → Parent) from the TalkGenAI Cloud dashboard so generated content nests under the right section of your site. Works for both Pages and, when a hierarchy plugin is active, Posts.
  • Fix: Interactive app widgets (calculators, tools) published from TalkGenAI Cloud now render correctly on the page — they are saved as proper apps and embedded via the [talkgenai_app] shortcode, so their styling and behaviour load through WordPress instead of appearing as raw code. These apps now also show up under TalkGenAI → My Apps.
  • Improvement: The Parent page picker now lists draft and private pages too, not just published ones.

2.7.2 – 2026-06-07

  • Fix: When an article is pushed as a draft, the plugin now stores its clean, permanent permalink (e.g. /blog/your-article/) instead of the temporary ?p=ID link. This lets TalkGenAI Cloud correctly match Google Search and AI traffic back to the article it generated.

2.7.1 – 2026-06-07

  • Feature: IndexNow integration — instantly notifies Bing, Yandex and other IndexNow engines whenever a post is published or updated, so new and refreshed content gets discovered in hours instead of days. Because ChatGPT Search and Perplexity draw on Bing’s index, this speeds up how fast AI search engines pick up your articles.
  • Feature: Article Type (optional) — choose a high-intent, buyer-focused format when generating an article: Comparison (X vs Y), Alternatives, or Best X for a use case. These structured formats are designed to get cited by AI search and convert. Leave it on “Standard article” for a normal blog post.
  • Feature: Pillar length option — generate in-depth pillar articles (2,500+ words) directly from the plugin, matching the TalkGenAI Cloud dashboard. Available on Growth and Agency plans.
  • Improvement: Self-contained and keyless — no Bing account or API key needed. Generates its own key, serves the verification file virtually (nothing written to disk), and stands down automatically if another IndexNow plugin (Microsoft IndexNow, Rank Math, Yoast SEO) is already active.

2.7.0 – 2026-05-24

  • Feature: Articles are now saved as native Gutenberg blocks — each heading, paragraph, list, and image becomes its own editable block instead of one large “Classic” block
  • Feature: New “Post Format” setting (Settings → Post Format) to choose between Gutenberg blocks (default) and plain HTML output
  • Improvement: Applies to both the in-plugin “Save as Draft” button and articles published from TalkGenAI Cloud

2.6.9 – 2026-05-22

  • Feature: WordPress category assignment when saving articles as draft (plugin UI + REST publish-article endpoint)
  • Feature: Default WordPress category from TalkGenAI Cloud integration settings applied on article creation
  • Improvement: Updated plugin listing copy and tags for WordPress.org
  • Improvement: Tested up to WordPress 7.0

2.6.8 – 2026-05-15

  • Feature: Connect WordPress site to TalkGenAI Cloud via one-time token (Settings → Generate Connection Token)
  • Feature: REST API for SaaS direct article publish to WordPress (draft/post, featured image, SEO meta, FAQ schema)
  • Feature: REST endpoint to set Yoast/RankMath SEO meta from TalkGenAI SaaS

2.6.7 – 2026-03-26

  • Improvement: External links validated on generation — broken links (404) removed, duplicates deduplicated, none placed in the intro paragraph
